_meta.note: Veteran 'Experts' deck. Total pips 9-15, per-skill 3-5, cost 9-16. earnableBoxes:0 — experts start maxed and CANNOT be retired (capability you buy, not legacy you grow). 3 per profession. Calibrated to sim expert bounds.

cards.name: Prof. Vivienne Hale
cards.flavour: Three honorary doctorates and a forger's eye. Publishes faster than peer review can keep up.

cards.name: Sir Roland Ash
cards.flavour: Spent forty years in archives no one else was allowed into. Knows where the bodies are filed.

cards.name: Dr. Octavia Crane
cards.flavour: War correspondent turned historian; reads a riot the way you read a footnote.

cards.name: Dr. Magnus Steel
cards.flavour: Designed two of the four modules. The Stabiliser obeys him out of respect.

cards.name: Inez Fuller
cards.flavour: Bomb-disposal background. Clears instability the way other people clear a table.

cards.name: Dr. Hari Bose
cards.flavour: Can build the Collimator a level higher than the manual says is possible.

cards.name: Prof. Cordelia Wexford
cards.flavour: Co-discovered time travel with you, once. Left to run her own lab. Hireable, for a price.

cards.name: Dr. Antón Reyes
cards.flavour: The one who proved Many Worlds was reachable. Wants to be there when the door opens.

cards.name: Dr. Sable Quint
cards.flavour: Has overclocked machines no one else would touch and walked away every time. So far. (Brave.)
